description: This file defines a class 'IntOrFloat' that provides a static method to evaluate and return a value as an integer when possible, or as a float otherwise, aiding in handling large numerical results in PHPSpreadsheet.

classes.name: IntOrFloat
classes.description: Provides a static method to evaluate a numeric value, returning it as an int if possible, or as a float otherwise to ensure correct operation with large results on 32-bit systems.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Returns the input value as an int if it equals its integer cast, otherwise returns the original float value.
